Subject: Ostrem Roofing - Submission Decline

Hi Celia,

Thank you for thinking of us for Ostrem Roofing. I appreciate the complete submission with all the documentation.

Unfortunately, we'll need to pass on this opportunity. Roofing contractors fall outside our current underwriting appetite, so we're not able to provide a competitive quote.

Given the risk profile, I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty contractor program or surplus lines market that focuses on roofing operations. They'll be better positioned to offer appropriate coverage and pricing for this class of business.

Please don't hesitate to reach out with future submissions that might be a better fit for our appetite.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
